primary_metric: Macro mean recovery@16 over cases after averaging seeds; the hierarchical skeleton-completion method versus the four frozen parent-strata v1 cells (official, unstratified, edge_count, parent_set) stored under runs/parent-dev and runs/parent-test.
split_rule: Identical case IDs, seeds, budget, sampling and seed schedule as the frozen parent-strata v1 protocol, so every skeleton cell pairs with the recorded v1 cells on the same case and seed. Only the skeleton_complete cells use fresh model inference; the four controls are the frozen v1 raw calls.
dev_decision: On the frozen dev split the complete variant reached R 18.34% versus 13.36% for parent_set, 9.79% for the enforce-only variant, and 4.25% for edge_count and unstratified. It beat every control on all four dev cases. The enforce-only variant, which reuses the parent_set wording and only post-processes the anchor edges, underperformed parent_set; therefore only skeleton_complete is frozen for test inference.
method_definition: Each attempt cycles over the a-priori parent-set strata of the most ambiguous anchor (same cycle as parent-strata v1). The stratum's parents are presented as already-fixed direct edges, the model is asked to output only the remaining edges it adds (at most max_edges minus the number of fixed edges), and the evaluated graph is the union of the fixed stratum edges and the parsed additions with any other edge into the anchor dropped. No coverage feedback, no graph-edit actions, no change to the edge-list representation.
